tools.name: cashctrl_list_accounts
tools.description: The chart of accounts: number, name, category and the balance for the fiscal period. Not paged. GET /account/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_account
tools.description: One account of the chart of accounts by id. GET /account/read.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_account_balance
tools.description: The balance of one account at the end of a day (default: the last day of the current fiscal period). GET /account/balance.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_account_categories
tools.description: The categories of the chart of accounts (assets, liabilities, expenses, revenue and their sub-categories). GET /account/category/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_bank_accounts
tools.description: The bank accounts set up in CashCtrl (name, IBAN, linked ledger account). GET /account/bank/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_journal
tools.description: Book entries of the journal (date, title, debit and credit account, amount, reference), newest first, for the current fiscal period unless fiscal_period_id is set. GET /journal/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_journal_entry
tools.description: One book entry by id, with its items for a collective entry. GET /journal/read.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_orders
tools.description: Sales or purchase documents (quotes, order confirmations, invoices, delivery notes, credit notes, vendor bills) with number, date, customer, status and total. Newest first. GET /order/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_order
tools.description: One order (invoice, quote, purchase document) by id, with its items, totals and status. GET /order/read.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_order_categories
tools.description: The order categories (Quote, Invoice, Credit note, Purchase invoice and so on) with their statuses (Draft, Open, Paid) and the default accounts and sequence numbers. Use it to find category_id and status_id (type PURCHASE for purchase documents). GET /order/category/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_persons
tools.description: Customers, vendors, employees and other contacts (name, company, number, roles, addresses). GET /person/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_person
tools.description: One person or company by id, with addresses, contact data and bank accounts. GET /person/read.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_articles
tools.description: Inventory articles (products and services) with number, name, price, stock and accounts. GET /inventory/article/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_article
tools.description: One inventory article by id. GET /inventory/article/read.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_salary_statements
tools.description: Payroll statements (employee, date, status, gross and net amounts), newest first. Sensitive personal data. GET /salary/statement/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_salary_statement
tools.description: One payroll statement by id, with its salary items. Sensitive personal data. GET /salary/statement/read.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_fiscal_periods
tools.description: All fiscal periods (id, name, start, end, current flag). The id is the fiscal_period_id of the other tools. GET /fiscalperiod/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_tax_codes
tools.description: The VAT tax codes (id, code, name, rates). The id is the tax_id of the write tools. GET /tax/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_sequence_numbers
tools.description: The number sequences (for journal references, order numbers, customer numbers). The id is the sequence_number_id of the write tools. GET /sequencenumber/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_list_currencies
tools.description: The currencies set up in CashCtrl with their exchange rates. GET /currency/list.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_report_tree
tools.description: The reports set up in CashCtrl (balance sheet, income statement, and so on) as a tree of collections and elements. The element id is the input of cashctrl_get_report_data. GET /report/tree.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_get_report_data
tools.description: The data of one report element (for example the balance sheet or the income statement) for a fiscal period or a date range. GET /report/element/data.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_create_journal_entry
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Creates a manual book entry in the journal. Either a simple entry (debit_account_id, credit_account_id, amount) or a collective entry (items, whose debit and credit sums must match)

tools.name: cashctrl_delete_journal_entries
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. DELETES manual journal entries by id (entries created by orders or salary statements cannot be deleted this way). Deleted entries are gone from the books; confirm the ids with the u

tools.name: cashctrl_create_order
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Creates ONE order document for ONE customer or vendor: a quote, invoice, credit note, purchase bill and so on, depending on category_id. Without status_id the first status of the ca

tools.name: cashctrl_update_order_status
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Sets the status of 1-20 orders (for example Draft to Open, or Open to Paid). A status can book journal entries or move stock, so the books change. POST /order/update_status.json.

tools.name: cashctrl_delete_orders
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. DELETES orders (invoices, quotes, purchase documents) by id, with the journal entries they created. Deleted documents are gone; confirm the ids with the user first. POST /order/dele

tools.name: cashctrl_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: changes the accounting records. Makes one request that is never repeated; check the result before trying again. Creates a customer, vendor or other contact. Give company, first_name or last_name (at least one). Search first with cashctrl_list_persons so no duplicate is created. POST /person/c

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cashctrl_create_journal_entry, cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_create_order, cashctrl_update_order_status, cashctrl_delete_orders, cashctrl_create_person · Private data: cashctrl_list_orders, cashctrl_get_order, cashctrl_list_order_categories, cashctrl_list_persons, cashctrl_get_person, cashctrl_create_journal_entry, cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_create_order, cashctrl_update_order_status, cashctrl_delete_orders, cashctrl_create_person · Public sink: cashctrl_create_journal_entry, cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_create_order, cashctrl_update_order_status, cashctrl_delete_orders, cashctrl_create_person · Destructive: cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_delete_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cashctrl_create_journal_entry, cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_create_order, cashctrl_update_order_status, cashctrl_delete_orders, cashctrl_create_person · Private data: cashctrl_list_orders, cashctrl_get_order, cashctrl_list_order_categories, cashctrl_list_persons, cashctrl_get_person, cashctrl_create_journal_entry, cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_create_order, cashctrl_update_order_status, cashctrl_delete_orders, cashctrl_create_person · Public sink: cashctrl_create_journal_entry, cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_create_order, cashctrl_update_order_status, cashctrl_delete_orders, cashctrl_create_person · Destructive: cashctrl_delete_journal_entries, cashctrl_delete_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
